mapper.sql: id, theme_code AS themeCode, area_name AS areaName, block_type AS blockType, block_title AS blockTitle, block_ref AS blockRef, sort, status
mapper.select: select from fly_area_block where theme_code = #{themeCode} order by area_name asc, sort asc, id asc
select from fly_area_block where theme_code = #{themeCode} and area_name = #{areaName} and status = 1 order by sort asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into fly_area_block (theme_code, area_name, block_type, block_title, block_ref, sort, status) values (#{themeCode}, #{areaName}, #{blockType}, #{blockTitle}, #{blockRef}, ifnull(#{sort}, 0), ifnull(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: update fly_area_block set sort = #{sort} where id = #{id}
update fly_area_block set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select max(sort) from fly_area_block where theme_code = #{themeCode} and area_name = #{areaName}
